newsitem.title: USA: USAir flight makes emergency landing in Indiana.
newsitem.headline: USAir flight makes emergency landing in Indiana.

text.p: A USAir flight from Phoenix to Pittsburgh made an emergency landing at Terre Haute Wednesday because of a possible fire but the passengers were evacuated safely, officials said.
The Boeing 757 with 171 passengers was given permission to make the landing at mid-afternoon and the plane landed "without incident," the Federal Aviation Administration said.

"(The plane) had indications of a problem," USAir spokesman Paul Turk said, adding that it was "diverted with possible fire." He could not confirm reports by cable television station MSNBC that smoke was detected in the back of the plane.
The passengers were evacuated by stairs, the FAA said.
Flight 158 was at the gate at the Terre Haute airport, where it was being inspected, Turk said. "Whatever (the problem) was, it was over when they got down on the ground."
